name: Server Health Check
content:
Run a full health check on the Ollama server.

Detail level: {{detail | select:options=["Summary","Full"]:default="Summary":required}}

Call `ollama_server_status` to check API reachability and list loaded (in-memory) models. Then call `ollama_list_models` to count pulled models. Report:
1. API status (reachable / unreachable)
2. Number of pulled models
3. Number of loaded models (with names and sizes)
4. Any concerns (e.g. no models pulled, server unreachable, memory pressure)

If the detail level is "Full", also call `ollama_hardware_detect` and include the GPU type and recommended compose configuration.

meta.description: Full Ollama server health check: API status, pulled models, loaded models, and optional hardware detail.
